name: v0.8.4
body:
## What's Changed
* Bump the cargo group across 1 directory with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/109
* polish: clear the remaining 0.8.0 tracker nits by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/116
* chore: stop tracking the .huginn agent working directory by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/117
* feat(editor): paste rich text as Markdown, and URL-over-selection as a link by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/118
* site: stop pinning the smoke test to one release version by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/120
* feat(editor): Focus mode — hide chrome, dim inactive paragraphs, centre the caret by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/121
* docs: make the README inviting and user-facing by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/119
* site: point docs pages at the rewritten README headings by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/122
* feat(core): per-note lock design and encryption envelope (#113) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/123
* ci: run the site workflow on every push and PR by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/124
* feat(graph): effect presets (Electric) and a subtle delete burn by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/125
* fix(graph): livelier arcs, more breathing room, no ghost edge lines by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/128
* fix(graph): spread the layout, dramatic arcs, stable edge bolts by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/129
* docs: add the graph-effects demo clip by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/127
* Release 0.8.4: bump version and changelog by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/126

## New Contributors
* @dependabot[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/109

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/compare/v0.8.3...v0.8.4
